title: 馬克白 2-1~2 弒君之夜
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, dark fantasy atmosphere
characters: Macbeth, a broad-shouldered warrior in dark plate armor, shoulder-length black hair, short black beard, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek

panels.prompt: castle courtyard at dead of night, a starless pitch-black sky above the battlements, one small torch flame, two figures walking

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 孩子，夜過了幾更了？
dialogue.en: How goes the night, boy?

dialogue.speaker: 弗里恩斯
dialogue.text: 月亮下去了，還沒聽見打鐘。
dialogue.en: The moon is down; I have not heard the clock.

panels.prompt: Banquo, a sturdy warrior with a thick braided beard, a raven feather pinned at his shoulder, handing his sword to Fleance, a slender boy carrying a torch, while glancing uneasily at the black sky

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 天上也講究節儉，把燈燭全熄了……慈悲的神明啊，抑制那些罪惡的思想，別讓它們潛入我的睡夢！
dialogue.en: There's husbandry in heaven; their candles are all out... Merciful powers, restrain in me the cursed thoughts that nature gives way to in repose!

panels.prompt: torchlight revealing {characters} emerging from the dark colonnade, Banquo's hand instinctively on his sword hilt

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.en: Who's there?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 一個朋友。
dialogue.en: A friend.

panels.prompt: Banquo, a sturdy warrior with a thick braided beard, speaking in a low voice, holding up a jeweled diamond that catches the torchlight

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 王上睡了，他今天非常高興——這顆金剛鑽，是他送給尊夫人的。……昨晚我夢見那三個女巫。她們對您說的話，有幾分應驗了。
dialogue.en: The King's a-bed... I dreamt last night of the three weird sisters: to you they have showed some truth.

panels.prompt: close-up of {characters} with half his face in deep shadow, a too-casual expression

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 我沒有想到她們。……等有了工夫再談吧。請安息。
dialogue.en: I think not of them... Good repose the while.

panels.prompt: {characters} alone in a vast dark hall, a spectral glowing dagger floating in the air before him, its handle turned toward his hand, he reaches for it with trembling fingers

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 在我面前搖晃、刀柄對著我的手的——不是一把刀子嗎？來，讓我抓住你！
dialogue.en: Is this a dagger which I see before me, the handle toward my hand? Come, let me clutch thee.

quote.text: 這是一把刀子嗎，在我眼前晃動？
quote.en: Is this a dagger which I see before me?

panels.prompt: his armored hand passing straight through the spectral dagger, and now thick drops of blood forming on its blade and hilt

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 抓不到你，卻仍舊看見你……你的刃上、柄上，還流著一滴滴剛才沒有的血！——沒有這樣的事，是殺人的惡念讓我看見這種異象。
dialogue.en: I have thee not, and yet I see thee still... on thy blade and dudgeon gouts of blood, which was not so before. There's no such thing: it is the bloody business which informs thus to mine eyes.

panels.prompt: {characters} stalking barefoot-quiet through a sleeping castle corridor, his shadow on the wall stretching into the shape of a gaunt wolf, sleeping servants unaware

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白（內心）
dialogue.text: 堅固的大地啊，別聽我的腳步聲往哪裡去——我怕連磚石都會洩漏我的行蹤。
dialogue.en: Thou sure and firm-set earth, hear not my steps, which way they walk, for fear thy very stones prate of my whereabout.

panels.prompt: a small bell swinging in the darkness, below it {characters} at the foot of a staircase leading up to the king's chamber door, one hand on the rail, face resolute

dialogue.speaker: 音效
dialogue.en: DONG—

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 鐘聲在招引我。不要聽它，鄧肯——這是召喚你上天堂、或下地獄的喪鐘。
dialogue.en: The bell invites me. Hear it not, Duncan, for it is a knell that summons thee to heaven or to hell.

panels.prompt: Lady Macbeth, a pale stately noblewoman with long straight black hair, piercing dark eyes, in a deep crimson gown with a high collar, alone by a dying fire, cheeks flushed with wine, listening intently

dialogue.speaker: 夫人
dialogue.text: 酒醉倒了他們，卻點起了我的火。聽——夜梟在啼，牠正鳴著喪鐘。……他動手了。
dialogue.en: That which hath made them drunk hath made me bold... It was the owl that shrieked, the fatal bellman... He is about it.

panels.prompt: an almost entirely black panel, only the silhouette of an owl with spread wings crossing a sliver of moonlight

dialogue.speaker: 音效
dialogue.en: SHRIEK—!

panels.prompt: Lady Macbeth in the crimson gown starting upright at a muffled voice, one hand gripping the mantel, knuckles white

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白（畫外）
dialogue.en: Who's there? What, ho!

dialogue.speaker: 夫人
dialogue.text: 噯喲——要是他們醒了、事情還沒辦好……毀掉我們的不是罪行，是失敗的企圖！倘不是他睡著的樣子像我的父親，我早就自己動手了。
dialogue.en: Alack, I am afraid they have awaked, and 'tis not done... Had he not resembled my father as he slept, I had done 't.

panels.prompt: {characters} descending a dark staircase toward the viewer, a bloody dagger hanging from each hand, his eyes hollow and unfocused

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 我把事情……辦好了。你沒聽見一個聲音嗎？
dialogue.en: I have done the deed. Didst thou not hear a noise?

panels.prompt: close-up of two blood-covered hands raised before a horrified face, blood running down the wrists into the armor

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 一個喊「上帝保佑我們」，一個喊「阿門」……我想跟著說「阿門」，卻哽在喉頭，怎麼也說不出來。
dialogue.en: One cried 'God bless us!' and 'Amen' the other... I could not say 'Amen' when they did say 'God bless us.'

panels.prompt: {characters} clutching his head in the darkness, surrounded by spectral screaming faces swirling in the black air around him, horror composition

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 我彷彿聽見一個聲音喊：「不要再睡了！馬克白已經殺害了睡眠——葛萊密斯殺害了睡眠，考特再也得不到睡眠，馬克白，再也得不到睡眠！」
dialogue.en: Methought I heard a voice cry 'Sleep no more! Macbeth does murder sleep'... 'Glamis hath murdered sleep, and therefore Cawdor shall sleep no more; Macbeth shall sleep no more.'

panels.prompt: Lady Macbeth in the deep crimson gown snatching the two bloody daggers from his frozen hands, her face cold and set

dialogue.speaker: 夫人
dialogue.text: 意志動搖的人！刀子給我。睡著的和死了的不過是畫像——只有小孩才怕畫裡的魔鬼。
dialogue.en: Infirm of purpose! Give me the daggers: the sleeping and the dead are but as pictures; 'tis the eye of childhood that fears a painted devil.

panels.prompt: {characters} staring at his outstretched bloody hands, behind him a visionary ocean rising in the darkness, its waves turning dark red where they touch him

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 不——是我這手上的血，要把無垠的碧海，染成一片殷紅。
dialogue.en: No, this my hand will rather the multitudinous seas incarnadine, making the green one red.

dialogue.speaker: 音效
dialogue.text: 叩！叩！
dialogue.en: KNOCK! KNOCK!

quote.text: 大洋裡所有的水，能洗淨我手上的血跡嗎
quote.en: Will all great Neptune's ocean wash this blood clean from my hand?

panels.prompt: Lady Macbeth in the crimson gown, her hands now bloody too, pulling the dazed warrior toward a doorway as knocking echoes, both looking back over their shoulders

dialogue.speaker: 夫人
dialogue.text: 我的手也跟你同色了——可我的心，羞於像你那樣慘白。一點點水就能泯除痕跡。披上睡衣，走！
dialogue.en: My hands are of your color, but I shame to wear a heart so white... A little water clears us of this deed.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 用你的敲門聲把鄧肯敲醒吧——我但願你能敲醒他！
dialogue.en: Wake Duncan with thy knocking! I would thou couldst!
